text: Sea's Monee (digital financial services) revenue grew faster than Grab's financial services segment in FY2025. Monee revenue rose 60.1% year-over-year, from US$2.4 billion in 2024 to US$3.8 billion (US$3,791.6 million) in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.100, p.104].
